# Source: Aristide Bruant

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Aristide Bruant
- **Artist / culture:** Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec French, 1864-1901
- **Date:** 1893
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** lithograph
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 13598
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/13598
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/31d7fb60-ddd1-c78d-1cc1-eca25cb603c1/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Typography

## Extracted source palette

`#C8A868, #182818, #F8F8E8, #D85808, #D87828, #F8E8C8, #383828, #D88848`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#0C150C`
- `surface`: `#283028`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#D85808`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#F8F8E8`
- `surface_variant`: `#283028`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#4E554E`
- `error`: `#D85808`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `inter` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `17.5:1`, surface `12.79:1`
- Variant contrast: `12.79:1`
- Control contrast: `4.95:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
